reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, parseDate/dayFromDate and captureBreadcrumb, but writes the daily weekend-skip rule inline rather than sharing it.

duplication.why: The daily-skip / non-daily-shift weekend policy already encoded in getNextDate is restated here, and the try/RSchedule/catch skeleton repeats getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: Handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts as the tree does for schedule handlers; the weekend-adjusted occurrence logic would sit better in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, an import and tests.

maintainability.why: Another independent copy of the weekend policy, an unexplained +/-3 day padding, and a dense unformatted flatMap/Set/filter one-liner.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the shift; no shared daily-skip function exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The flatMap in getDatesInRange re-expresses getNextDate's daily weekend filter plus non-daily getDateWithSkippedWeekend shift in a reshaped form.
